```{=html}
<!-- ── Navbar ─────────────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div class="custom-navbar">
  <div class="navbar-brand">
    <a href="/"><img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="navbar-logo"></a>
    <h1>Appalachian A.I. Corps</h1>
  </div>
  <button class="navbar-toggle" onclick="toggleMenu()">&#9776;</button>
  <nav class="navbar-links" id="navbarLinks">
    <a href="/">Home</a> | <a href="modules">Modules</a> | <a href="team">Team</a> | <a href="contact">Contact</a>
  </nav>
  <div class="nav-auth-wrapper">
    <div class="nav-auth-btn" id="authBtn" onclick="toggleAuthDropdown(event)">
      <img src="assets/profile-placeholder.jpg" alt="Profile" class="nav-auth-avatar" id="authAvatar">
      <span id="authLabel">Log In</span>
      <span class="nav-auth-chevron" id="authChevron">&#9662;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-auth-dropdown" id="authDropdown">
      <div id="loggedOutMenu">
        <a href="login-student">Student</a>
        <a href="login-teacher">Teacher</a>
      </div>
      <div id="loggedInMenu" style="display:none;">
        <a href="#" id="dashboardLink" style="display:none;">Teacher Dashboard</a>
        <a href="#" onclick="logOut()">Log Out</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── Page content ───────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div class="auth-page">
  <div class="auth-card">
    <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="auth-logo">
    <h2>Teacher Sign Up</h2>
    <p class="auth-subtitle">Create your teacher account</p>
    <div id="errorMsg" class="auth-error" style="display:none;"></div>
    <div id="successMsg" class="auth-success" style="display:none;"></div>
    <form id="signupForm" onsubmit="return false;">
      <label for="username">Username</label>
      <input type="text" id="username" placeholder="Choose a username" required>
      <label for="email">Email</label>
      <input type="email" id="email" placeholder="Enter your email" required>
      <label for="password">Password</label>
      <input type="password" id="password" placeholder="Create a password (min 6 characters)" required minlength="6">
      <button type="submit" class="auth-btn" id="signupBtn">Sign Up</button>
    </form>
    <div class="auth-links">
      Already have an account? <a href="login-teacher">Log In</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ── Popup overlay for success ──────────────────────────── -->
<div id="signupPopup" class="popup-overlay" style="display:none;">
  <div class="popup-card">
    <h3>Account Created</h3>
    <p>A verification email has been sent to <strong id="popupEmail"></strong>.</p>
    <p>Please check your inbox and click the verification link before logging in.</p>
    <button class="auth-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('signupPopup').style.display='none'; window.location.href='login-teacher';">Got it</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="js/supabase-config.js"></script>
<script src="js/auth.js"></script>
<script>
document.getElementById('signupForm').addEventListener('submit', async () => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('signupBtn');
  const errorMsg = document.getElementById('errorMsg');
  const username = document.getElementById('username').value.trim();
  const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById('password').value;

  if (!username || !email || !password) return;

  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = 'Creating account...';
  errorMsg.style.display = 'none';

  try {
    // Check if username is already taken
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('id')
      .eq('username', username)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (existing) throw new Error('That username is already taken. Please choose another.');

    // Sign up via Supabase Auth
    const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
      email,
      password,
      options: {
        data: { username, role: 'teacher' }
      }
    });
    if (error) throw error;

    // Create profile row
    const { error: profileErr } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .insert({
        id: data.user.id,
        username,
        role: 'teacher',
        teacher_id: null
      });
    if (profileErr) throw profileErr;

    // Sign out immediately (they need to verify email first)
    await supabase.auth.signOut();

    // Show success popup
    document.getElementById('popupEmail').textContent = email;
    document.getElementById('signupPopup').style.display = 'flex';

  } catch (err) {
    errorMsg.textContent = err.message;
    errorMsg.style.display = 'block';
    btn.disabled = false;
    btn.textContent = 'Sign Up';
  }
});
</script>
<script>
function toggleMenu() {
  document.getElementById('navbarLinks').classList.toggle('show');
}
</script>
```
